readings.enthusiastic: {bishop}'s letter to the clergy came within the week: he welcomes {doc} with gratitude, asks that it be put into effect in every parish at once, and says the chancery will be watching.
readings.faithful: {bishop} sent the text to every parish with a covering letter: {doc} is to be received in the spirit in which it was given, and guidelines will follow from the chancery.
readings.minimal: {bishop}'s covering letter ran to two paragraphs. {doc} is in force, he writes, and nothing in the diocese's practice needs to change in haste.
readings.slow: The chancery said nothing for a month. Then a line in the diocesan paper: {bishop} is studying {doc} with his consultors, and priests are asked to make no changes until he writes.
